[[Arachni's Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] obtained from [[Arachni's Spoils]], a [[chest]] that spawns after killing [[Arachni]] in [[Arachni's Haunt]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] 20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item shares the same [[skin]] as a [[Forked Hornbow]].
